notes.title: 1.1.4.1 Update
notes.content: Various updates to gameplay, bug fixes, UI improvements

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.1.4
notes.content:
We’re on to update 1.4. Thanks to all the players who’ve shared ideas (and told me about bugs). Keep the feedback coming!

Here’s what’s new and fun in the latest full version and free demo.

Look out above. There’s a new Flying Enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/23132e6a2f04e9a9af67bb7c6b8e08423dbac0f7.gif

Bam double bam! Get yourself a new weapon, the Hard Ways. It’s an illegally modified Heavy Assault Weapon - less damage per shot but it fires two shots simultaneously. Can be randomly acquired from the Weapon Fence or unlocked permanently via reinvestment (full game only).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/7a7c426b258e5b19e19fa44ae22124a163c56db9.gif

Plus some tweaks here and there to user experience and your ability to control how you play:

 Gameplay update to pre-populate enemies on levels
 UI update to move narration text below game screen
 Press space to fast-forward narration text
 Allow user to set music and sound effects volume
 Fixed defect where 'move left' key couldn't be set from in-game menu


Climb the tower now! Twenty floors of sneaking and shooting await you…

So play now! And join our mailing list for weapon unlock codes, inside tips and more.

notes.title: It took all of 2020, but it's here - Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
The FREE DEMO is now available! Play the first few levels of the game - sneak n' shoot, explore edge levels, even engage in a boss fight! 

Anyone who signs up for our mailing list (including demo users!) will receive an unlock  code for the Ronin silenced assault rifle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/0650a1c525b9eb113cc17ae05f9b47b95d134cd2.gif

On to the details...

This update isn’t all about the bigger, badder weapons. I’m excited to share other stuff too, not just the elegant but lethal Laser Cannon and the punked out Street Sweeper. Not only the Heavy Assault Weapon, your basic noisy bullet hose. There’s more to this update than the Ronin Assault Rifle, now yours to unlock to up your stealth game. But it’s hard not to lead with the big guns.

(Especially when one of them has rockets.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/5aeb012e13b2f56b47ef534ad1b0e190f881ddf6.gif

Truly, it’s not just about the weapons. The latest version of Contract Work also gives you new environments to explore and new objectives and structures for the game. It’s more roguelike, with 20 continuous floors of sneaking and shooting. And there’s more to discover on each level. Think hidden edge sectors where you can explore the black market. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/5e43cb69fee5ef5b7407ef215286a663676ba782.gif

Think vending machines with a variety of…effects. The 'Blood Bank' which rewards pain with gain, the 'Ammo Market' to sell your ordinance to the highest bidder, or the 'Weapon Fence' who will gladly swap weapons for a couple bucks, no questions asked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/fd4b9942e98aefd85796d1869127ddf1897b4a1f.gif

For the stealthy, now you can sneak up on robots and silently stun them. This non-lethal takedown will freeze a bot for a short period of time... but you will have to deal with it repowering later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/a6e1a85ea18e6995ec146c73530a6cd176496c1e.gif

And the new boss. Look out for it. It’s waiting to destroy you. (Let ‘em try!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/abb13d14930b0a2813c6ec79347a2a0691237136.gif

There’s a bunch of new content stuff, too, like reworked graphics, animations and effects, a new city background, even new music. Better performance. And a whole load of squashed bugs. (Hopefully all the bugs, but if you notice anything, drop me a message so I can fix it.)

Thanks to everyone who shared feedback and ideas for the update! Couldn’t have done it without you. And if you haven’t played yet… just think of all that firepower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166439/4252ff08dfd5e52f2496af143e450a2774b96eb3.gif
